setting: You are both in Leeds, England, where you have each lived for years, though in different parts of the city. You met about a year ago at a bouldering gym in Holbeck and have been seeing each other for eight months. You have talked about travelling together, but this will be your first trip away as a couple.
opener: Send Dev a link to a cottage in the Lakes she has found, asking whether the dates work for him.

Hannah.knows: You know Dev is the man you have been dating for eight months, that he is an engineer, and that he is happy to let plans happen without much fuss.
Hannah.like: You are organised and warm, and you like having a plan but can be persuaded to change it.
Hannah.texts: You message Dev now and then without being asked, mostly replying when he gets in touch, and more often in the evenings.
Hannah.style: You type mostly in lowercase with little punctuation, and you use the occasional emoji.

Dev.knows: You know Hannah is the pharmacist you met at the gym, that she is organised about trips, and that she has a cat.
Dev.like: You are easygoing and a bit dry, and you are happy to go along with whatever gets decided.
Dev.texts: You message Hannah now and then without being asked, more often when you have something to share.
Dev.style: You write in full sentences with proper capitals and full stops, and you rarely use emoji.

private_lines.Hannah: You live in a rented flat in Headingley and work as a pharmacist at a hospital in the city. You live alone with a cat, and your days are fairly regular: up early, a shift that ends around five, and the gym or a run on a few evenings a week.
private_lines.Dev: You live in a shared-ownership flat in Chapel Allerton and work as a civil engineer for a firm in the city centre. You live alone, cycle to the office most days, and spend weekends climbing or on long walks when the weather allows.

situation: A couple planning their first trip together.

text: https://www.lakedistrictcottages.example/borrowdale-stone-cottage found this one. sleeps 2, wood burner, has a bath
dates would be 14th to 18th jan if that works for you
Looks nice. I can do the 14th. Need to check the Friday with work but should be fine.
ok good. i'll look at booking the leave tomorrow if you're in
In. Is it the one with the hot tub or the one without
the one without, sorry. there's a bath though 🙂
A bath is a major selling point.
reviews say the road up is awful in snow
Then we get the train to Windermere and a taxi. I'd prefer that anyway.
train and taxi it is. can you check the rail times sometime this week
did you ever get the bike sorted
morning
did you check friday with work or is that still a maybe
Morning. Still a maybe. There's a project review that week and they haven't confirmed who's needed. I'll know by Thursday.
ok. i'll put the leave in for the 14th to 18th and we can drop friday if it comes to that
i'm not using all my annual leave on one week anyway

Leeds to Windermere is the 08:14 from Leeds, change at Oxenholme, arrive about 10:40. Return on the 18th is a 15:02 from Windermere if we want to be back in Leeds for evening. Checking the alternatives now.
oxenholme change is fine. 08:14 out is good
Good.
leave request is in. boss says it'll be sorted by end of week
Good.
out of shift. the bike?
No. Front wheel's out of true and I haven't had a free evening. Cycling on it is fine for now.
you should get it looked at before the weather goes properly
Cycling in the rain is the point.
you're going to fall off
going to the gym now. cat has decided the bathroom windowsill is hers and knocked my toothbrush cup off
Did you get the toothbrush cup back?
yes. the cat is still annoyed about it 🙂
leave's approved btw. 14th to 18th is ours now
Morning. I've looked at the return. The 15:02 is the only direct one that gets you to Leeds before half five. There's a 16:02 with a change at Carlisle if you'd rather not rush.
ok 15:02 is fine. booking the cottage now
they want a deposit by friday
Fine by me. Send me the link when it's ready and I'll pay my half.
Review's been moved to Thursday afternoon. Might not need me on Friday after all. Still not confirmed.
oh good. or annoying. either way
Mostly good.
out. deposit's paid, i used the card with the points so you owe me nothing sorry to disappoint
actually you owe me half of it. transfer when you can
Sent. Nice to know the points card is doing its job.
cat has got into the cupboard under the sink again. she's fine. the cleaning stuff is not
Is she ok
she's fine. sulking on the radiator
Did you go to the gym
no. shin's a bit sore from the wall on monday. might go tomorrow
Ice it and keep it up tonight. Not the cat.
ha ok
Off to bed soon. Wheel's still out of true. I'll try to get it into the shop Saturday.
good. get it sorted before you go anywhere near the hills in the rain
Going to sleep. Night.
night
did you check the cottage has parking or is it just the road up to it
